statuses.implemented-equivalent: Expose a Rust API with substantially equivalent capability and observable behavior.
statuses.implemented-adapted: Preserve the capability/behavior but intentionally use a Rust-native API or ownership/type model.
statuses.unsupported-webgl-specific: Exclude because the API exists specifically for WebGL and has no meaningful WebGPU role.
statuses.unsupported-js-specific: Exclude only when the API expresses JavaScript runtime semantics with no useful Rust engine capability.
statuses.deferred: Known useful capability intentionally outside this MVP; must have an explicit frozen rationale.

member_policy: All generated public/protected-like members inherit the containing exported type's default_status unless listed in member_overrides. member_adaptations further constrain the Rust-side shape of known JavaScript-specific APIs.

member_adaptations.rust_mapping: typed Rust storage such as Vec<T>, Box<[T]>, or an internal shared buffer abstraction
member_adaptations.requirement: Preserve element type, length, normalized interpretation, mutation results, and upload behavior; JavaScript TypedArray object identity is not required.
A mutation notification must invalidate/upload GPU data equivalently; a JavaScript setter is not required.

member_adaptations.requirement: Preserve the useful post-upload lifecycle hook without JavaScript Function identity semantics.
Preserve stride/offset aliasing semantics safely; JavaScript ArrayBuffer identity is not required.
Support add/has/remove/dispatch capability and safe removal during dispatch; JavaScript this-binding and arbitrary mutable JS event objects are not required.

member_adaptations.rust_mapping: scene-node handles managed by the scene graph
member_adaptations.requirement: Preserve one-parent invariant, child ordering, add/remove/attach behavior, traversal, and world-transform semantics without exposing self-referential Rust references.

member_adaptations.rust_mapping: serializable metadata map/value, e.g. serde_json::Map<String, Value>
member_adaptations.requirement: Support arbitrary serializable application metadata; JavaScript functions/prototypes/object identity are not required.

member_adaptations.rust_mapping: typed query APIs plus direct id/name queries
member_adaptations.requirement: Preserve practical scene lookup capability; arbitrary string-based reflection over every Rust field is not required.

member_adaptations.rust_mapping: Rust render hooks/closures or trait hooks
member_adaptations.requirement: Preserve per-object pre/post render extension capability without JavaScript callback identity semantics.
Built-in renderable object types must provide behavior compatible with r186 raycasting; arbitrary JavaScript method overrides are not required.
Renderable object types must expose the equivalent culling capability without JavaScript subclass dispatch.

member_adaptations.rust_mapping: Rust serialization for supported scene data
member_adaptations.requirement: Serialize the supported MVP scene/resource model deterministically; fields belonging exclusively to deferred subsystems may remain absent until those subsystems are implemented.
Preserve thresholds and per-object-type raycasting configuration without an untyped JavaScript dictionary.

member_adaptations.requirement: Preserve Page Visibility behavior without requiring callers to pass a raw JavaScript Document object.

member_adaptations.requirement: Resource reclamation must be deterministic/observable enough for lifecycle tests; GC-style event-driven cleanup is not required.
